claims.claim: The development release separates data, model, robustness, and manuscript layers.
The method selects conservative conformal uncertainty and material protocol masked multimodal representation policies.
Five essential modules run under paired units, equal budgets, and frozen group splits.
The largest observed paired effect is 0.110 in the fixture.
Calibration gains and OOD RMSE gains are retained as separate evidence fields.
Outcome-independent OOD grouping narrows applicability and abstains on six low-n groups.
The agent suite covers seven tasks and selects single-agent mode under the frozen fixture.
The manuscript excludes protected results, unsupported causal language, and blocked module claims.
